title: 第7章 和丧尸来个拥抱第8章 年少不知少妇好
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: 女人没有丝毫犹豫，跑过林羽身侧的时候，双手猛的推向林羽。
如果是个普通人，毫无防备之下被如此猛推，绝对会站立不稳，摔倒在地。
此刻倒地，意味着死亡！
然而。
女子带着冲过来的力量双手推出，却彷佛推在了一座大石头上，无法撼动。
接着，她就感觉右手被人拉住！
然後，她就飞了出去。
有着末世经验的林羽，怎麽可能被这种女人算计呢。
从她眼底露出的一抹疯狂，林羽就知道了对方的心思。
这女人真是厕所里打灯笼，找屎。
他瞬间抓住女人的右手，微微用力，直接将女人甩向奔来的丧尸。
女人如篮球般飞出，和丧尸撞了个满怀，拥抱在了一起。
两道身影一起滚落在地上，她口中发出了痛苦的呻吟。
不等她起身，丧尸直接猛扑向她，狰狞的嘴巴直接咬住了女人的脖子。
鲜血喷涌，凄厉的惨叫响起。
她双腿胡乱的蹬着，在绝望中慢慢挣扎，在痛苦中缓缓死去。
她的头正对着林羽的方向，看着那道笔直的身影，她脑海中尽是後悔。
林羽静静的看着这一幕，心中很是平静。
如果这女人没有小心思，不想着去害林羽，她应该是得救了。
顺手而为的事，很简单！
前世十年的末世挣扎，并没有让林羽的心变得无情。
相反，有很多的人愿意为他前仆後继的赴死，他也为了兄弟拚死守护过。
这个世界，没有绝对的黑白，也没有绝对的善恶。绝对的自私利己主义者，会死得更加惨。
前世。
传闻最强序列第一人，代号曙光的那个强者，拥有着s级天赋：绝对净化。
他一旦施展，但凡在他这招技能范围内的所有人，都会被动接受规则的审判。
无法逃脱，无法避免。
规则会判定一个人的内心，黑暗或是光明。
一旦判定内心恶大於善，将接受审判，被绝对净化，烟消云散。
前世，曙光所到之处，无数强者纷纷退避。
绝对规则，真的让人无力。
所以，林羽可以冷酷，但不会无情。
content_en:
The woman didn't hesitate at all. When she ran past Lin Yu, she pushed Lin Yu fiercely with both hands.
If he were an ordinary person and was pushed so hard without warning, he would definitely lose his balance and fall to the ground.
Falling to the ground at this moment means death!
However.
The woman pushed it out with both hands with the strength to rush towards her, but it seemed as if she was pushed against a big rock and could not be shaken.
Then, she felt someone holding her right hand!
Then, she flew out.
How could Lin Yu, who had experience in the apocalypse, be plotted by such a woman.
From the look of madness in her eyes, Lin Yu knew what the other party was thinking.
This woman is really lighting a lantern in the toilet, looking for shit.
He instantly grabbed the woman's right hand, exerted a slight force, and threw the woman directly towards the running zombies.
"Bang"
The woman flew out like a basketball, bumped into the zombies, and hugged each other.
The two figures rolled to the ground together, and she moaned in pain.
Before she could get up, the zombie pounced directly on her, biting the woman's neck with its ferocious mouth.
"Ah~"
Blood spurted out, and shrill screams rang out.
She kicked her legs wildly, struggling slowly in despair, and died slowly in pain.
Her head was facing Lin Yu's direction, looking at the straight figure, her mind was filled with regret.
Lin Yu watched this scene quietly, feeling very calm in his heart.
If this woman didn't have any small thoughts and didn't want to harm Lin Yu, she should be saved.
It’s a simple thing to do casually!
The ten years of apocalyptic struggle in his previous life did not make Lin Yu's heart ruthless.
On the contrary, there were many people who were willing to die for him one after another, and he also defended his brothers to the death.
In this world, there is no absolute black and white, nor absolute good and evil. Absolutely selfish egoists will die even more miserably.
previous life.
It is rumored that the strongest person in the strongest sequence, the strong man codenamed Shuguang, possesses an S-level talent: absolute purification.
Once he uses it, everyone within the scope of his skill will passively accept the judgment of the rules.
There is no escape, no avoidance.
Rules will determine a person's heart, darkness or light.
Once it is judged that the evil in one's heart is greater than the good, one will be judged, absolutely purified, and vanished into thin air.
In the previous life, wherever the light of dawn reached, countless powerful people retreated.
Absolute rules are really powerless.
Therefore, Lin Yu can be cold, but not ruthless.
title_en: Chapter 7 A hug with the zombies Chapter 8 Young people don’t know how good a young woman is
